answer: Work-slot bond: each identity locks 70 and claims one slot on a jetty roster. The slot must finish one terrace task per epoch; an auditor measures the delta between claimed and delivered work, and any gap burns the bond. Slot k costs 42+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 4,038,000 plus 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. Rented slots fail: each slot's key signs its own task, so a reused key burns both bonds. One honest identity pays 42 once, keeps its slot.
